# BP Diary

BP Diary is a free browser-based Hindi case diary and letter writing tool for Bihar Police investigating officers. It provides Hinglish typing, voice typing, A4 print, PDF export, and optional Google Drive backup. All data is stored locally on the user's device.

## Key Pages

- Home (https://bpdiary.arverma.dev/): Write case diaries and letters in Hindi with A4 print and PDF export
- Help (https://bpdiary.arverma.dev/help): How to use BP Diary, Hindi typing, privacy, and shortcuts
- Hindi guide (https://bpdiary.arverma.dev/guide/case-diary-kaise-likhein): How to write a Bihar Police case diary in Hindi
- English guide (https://bpdiary.arverma.dev/guide/bihar-police-case-diary-format): Case diary format and writing instructions

## About

BP Diary follows the Schedule 47, Form 120A layout for Bihar Police case diaries as per BNSS Section 192. Features include Hinglish transliteration, voice typing, punctuation panel, A4 printing, PDF export, and local storage with optional Google Drive backup.

Not an official Bihar Police product. Independent tool for investigating officers.
